name: SUX
description: SUX is an entertainment-only meme token experiment built around an $80 public budget challenge. No profit promises. It can go to zero.
targetSupplyNote: Target supply is 1,000,000,000 SUX with 2 decimals. A standard launchpad route may fit the 1B supply narrative, but use manual SPL or a custom-supply tool if decimals=2 must be enforced.

manualSplFallback.mintAuthorityPolicy: Mint full supply once, then revoke mint authority.
manualSplFallback.freezeAuthorityPolicy: Do not enable freeze authority. If enabled by a tool, revoke it before public launch.
manualSplFallback.metadataUpdatePolicy: Keep update authority only until URLs and metadata render correctly, then either revoke it or publicly document who controls it.

launchpadRoute.name: SUX
launchpadRoute.initialBuyPolicy: Use zero or the smallest allowed amount. Document any creator purchase publicly.
launchpadRoute.pairToken: SOL by default; USDC only if the launch UI supports it and the community expects a stable quote.
launchpadRoute.supplyPolicy: Only use this route if the UI explicitly supports a fixed 1,000,000,000 SUX supply and 2 decimals.

publicRiskNote: SUX is entertainment-only. It is not financial advice, does not promise profit, and can go to zero.
